external_entities.name: Suppliers
external_entities.description: Suppliers who upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category managers
external_entities.description: Category managers who review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The supplier document portal vendor that hosts the SaaS product and pushes nightly supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.
processes.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: Service that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor-hosted platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: Cloud storage bucket receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a landing bucket in our cloud account
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: Database into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Suppliers sign in to the portal using vendor-issued credentials.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork, including insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection

data_flows.name: store documents
data_flows.description: The portal stores uploaded supplier documents in the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.data_description: compliance paperwork and staff contact details

data_flows.name: push data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description: "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." System description: "The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These claims conflict, so encryption in transit is unknown.

data_flows.name: pick up file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service picks up the supplier extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes the extracted supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and vendor platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform contains confidential data because it stores supplier compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that compliance documents and contact details for suppliers' staff remain in the vendor platform.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data because it stores the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the landing bucket receives a supplier data extract, which includes supplier records derived from the stated paperwork and contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database contains confidential data because it stores supplier records.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
